articles.title: India’s Fuel Consumption Drops 6.5% In May Amid Price Hikes, Supply Disruption
articles.titleEn: India’s Fuel Consumption Drops 6.5% In May Amid Price Hikes, Supply Disruption
articles.summary: India’s consumption of petroleum products fell 6.5% in May to 19.93 million tonnes, mainly due to higher fuel prices and global supply disruptions from the West Asia conflict. While LPG demand plunged sharply, petrol and diesel usage rose. Exports of refined products also declined, reflecting tightening market conditions and policy changes
